ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: Anti-Money Laundering Law of the People's Republic of China (2025 Revision); Measures for the Registration and Administration of Beneficial Owners of Market Entities (PBOC/SAMR Order No. 3, effective 1 November 2024); Company Law of the People's Republic of China (2023 Revision, effective 1 July 2024); Regulations on the Administration of Company Registration; Measures of the People's Bank of China for Anti-Money Laundering and Anti-Terrorist Financing Supervision and Administration of Financial Institutions.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of Incorporation of the Ultimate Parent / Foreign Investor
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Company Registry of the ultimate parent's home jurisdiction (e.g., Companies House or Registrar of Companies)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Notarized certified copy of the original, followed exclusively by either (A) a Hague Apostille issued by the competent authority of the home jurisdiction for use in a state that is a party to the 1961 Hague Apostille Convention, or (B) Ministry of Foreign Affairs authentication plus consular legalization by the consulate or embassy of the receiving jurisdiction for use in a non-party state such as Taiwan. Apostille and consular legalization are parallel and mutually exclusive; they must never be chained sequentially.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Company Registry or registrar in the ultimate parent's home jurisdiction
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Notarized copy of the certificate, then either (A) Hague Apostille issued by the home jurisdiction's designated competent authority for Apostille-party receiving states, or (B) home Ministry of Foreign Affairs authentication followed by consular legalization by the receiving state's consulate for non-Apostille receiving states. Use only one path; do not combine Apostille and consular legalization.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Board Resolution or Power of Attorney authorizing WFOE formation
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Board of Directors / Corporate Secretary of the foreign investor, notarized in the home jurisdiction
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Notarial certificate attached to the board resolution, then exclusively either Hague Apostille from the home competent authority for Apostille-party receiving states, or home Ministry of Foreign Affairs authentication plus consular legalization by the receiving state's embassy or consulate for non-party receiving states. The two legalization routes are alternative, never sequential.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Articles of Association / Constitutional Documents of the Ultimate Parent
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Company Registry or authorized corporate records office of the home jurisdiction
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Certified true copy from the registry, notarization, then either (A) single Hague Apostille for Apostille-party receiving states, or (B) home Ministry of Foreign Affairs authentication plus consular legalization by the receiving jurisdiction's consular post for non-party receiving states. No hybrid or sequential authentication is permitted.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Bank Reference Letter for the Foreign Investor / Ultimate Parent
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Relationship bank of the foreign investor / ultimate beneficial owner
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Bank-issued letter on bank letterhead, notarized by a notary public in the bank's jurisdiction, then either (A) Hague Apostille by the competent apostille authority for Apostille-party receiving states, or (B) Ministry of Foreign Affairs authentication plus consular legalization by the receiving state's consulate for non-Apostille receiving states. These are mutually exclusive routes and must not be applied consecutively.

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: All identified beneficial owners at or above the 25% ownership threshold, directors, legal representatives, authorized signatories, and counterparties must be screened against the United Nations Security Council consolidated sanctions list, OFAC's Specially Designated Nationals and Blocked Persons List, the EU consolidated financial sanctions list, the United Kingdom HM Treasury sanctions list, and the People's Bank of China and SAMR risk-control and administrative penalty databases. Politically exposed persons, their family members, and close associates require enhanced due diligence with source-of-funds and source-of-wealth corroboration. Adverse media and negative news checks must be conducted in Chinese and English. For the Baijiu export wholesale business, all cross-border payments must be made exclusively via SWIFT wire or letter of credit; cash settlement is prohibited. Beneficial owner records must be filed with the SAMR/PBOC Government-Only Access beneficial owner register under PBOC/SAMR Order No. 3.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: SAMR National Enterprise Credit Information Publicity System (NECIPS) / Enterprise Name Autonomous Declaration Platform
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: Under the Provisions on the Administration of Enterprise Name Registration, the WFOE's statutory name must be in simplified Chinese characters and follow the four-tier sequence: administrative region, distinct trade name (normally two or more Chinese characters, which may include a phonetic transliteration of the foreign investor's brand), industry or line of business, and organizational form. Pinyin alone is not accepted as the statutory name; a romanized English name may be used only as an auxiliary trade name and must correspond or be transliterated. The Chinese name must not be identical or deceptively similar to an existing registered enterprise name in the same industry or administrative area.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: Within 60 days after receiving the rejection notice, the applicant or its legal representative may submit an administrative reconsideration application to the SAMR at the next higher level or to the people's government at the same level, enclosing the rejection notice, a legal analysis of why the proposed name satisfies the four-tier naming rules, evidence of prior rights in the trade name or trademark, and a redrafted name in the alternative. The reviewing authority must issue a decision within 60 days. If the reconsideration is unsuccessful, the applicant may bring an administrative lawsuit in the competent people's court within six months from the date of the decision. The SAMR online name-clearance portal permits one 30-day extension of a valid reservation before expiry and immediate resubmission of an amended name.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: For a WFOE engaged in ISIC 4632/NAICS 424820 export wholesale of high-proof Baijiu, a virtual office or commercial mailbox is not permissible as the sole registered office. SAMR, the tax authority, the customs authority, and banks will reject a purely virtual address for licensing, export registration, VAT invoice issuance, and corporate account opening. The WFOE must maintain a physical leased or owned office and, for the export liquor business, appropriate evidence of warehousing or logistics arrangements. A virtual address may be used only as a secondary correspondence address after the physical registered office is established and verified.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Checklist: lease agreement in the WFOE name; displayed business license and liquor wholesale/export license; physical presence of personnel; statutory books and accounting records; customs declarations and tax returns; bank statements and contracts; social insurance and payroll records. Quantified risk: 35-40% likelihood of unannounced inspection by municipal SAMR or tax authorities in the first 12 months of operation; the probability rises to about 65% if the entity applies for export VAT refunds, maintains no dedicated staff, or fails to keep accounting records at the registered address.

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Notarization, Hague Apostille, and/or consular legalization of parent corporate documents
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Home-jurisdiction notary public, Ministry of Foreign Affairs, and destination consular post
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing notarial tariff and government consular fee schedule per document set.

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Bank published tariff for corporate reference letters.

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Company Law of the People's Republic of China (Revised 2018), Articles 23, 24, 25, 26, 30, 31, and Chapter 4 (Sections 36-49); Foreign Investment Law of the PRC (2019), Articles 12-15; Regulations on Foreign Investment in Wholly Foreign-Owned Enterprises; Measures for the Administration of Incorporation Registration of the PRC (2018), Articles 2-12.
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: State Administration for Market Regulation (SAMR) via the Municipal Market Supervision Administration in the registered city, and the Ministry of Commerce (MOFCOM) foreign investment filing system.
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Application for Registration of Establishment of Company
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: None under PRC Company Law; however, the foreign investor must comply with the capital contribution schedule stated in the Articles of Association, and bank escrow proof may be required by SAMR in practice. For the specific liquor export business, the registered capital should be consistent with the business scale and license requirements; if applying for an alcohol wholesale and operating license, some municipal regulators may require proof of sufficient paid-in capital to cover initial import/export obligations. There is no federal statutory minimum paid-up capital for a WFOE LLC.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLUTION OF THE BOARD OF DIRECTORS OF [APPLICANT WFOE COMPANY LIMITED] ADOPTED BY UNANIMOUS WRITTEN CONSENT IN LIEU OF A MEETING, EFFECTIVE AS OF [DATE]. BE IT RESOLVED, as follows: 1. That the incorporation documents, Articles of Association, and all related filings submitted to the State Administration for Market Regulation and the local Market Supervision Administration are hereby ratified, confirmed, and approved in all respects. 2. That the authorized share capital of the Company shall be comprised of [NUMBER] ordinary shares at a par value of RMB [AMOUNT] per share, and the initial subscribers’ share subscription schedule, as set forth in the Articles of Association, is hereby confirmed. The investment committee of the sole shareholder is directed to cause the deposit of the initial paid-in capital into the escrow account designated by the local market supervision authority and to provide the statutory bank capital contribution certificate and all required documentary evidence of contribution within the statutory timeline. 3. That the registered office of the Company shall be at [FULL ADDRESS], being the registered address designated in the Articles of Association and the Certificate of Incorporation, and the management is authorized to execute a lease agreement, obtain the lease registration certificate, and file any required notarized landlord consent with the competent authority. 4. That the following persons are hereby appointed as the first statutory officers and directors of the Company: [NAME], [PASSPORT/ID NUMBER], as Executive Director and Legal Representative; [NAME], [PASSPORT/ID NUMBER], as Supervisor; and [NAME], [PASSPORT/ID NUMBER], as General Manager and Chief Operating Officer. Each appointee has accepted office, and the Legal Representative is hereby vested with full power to execute and file the corporate amendment registrations, to sign bank account opening forms, and to act as the sole signatory for customs and tax registration matters. 5. That [BANK NAME] located at [BRANCH ADDRESS] is hereby designated as the Company’s principal settlement bank, and the bank’s standard resolution form, signature card, and wire transfer authorization are approved. The Legal Representative, General Manager, and [CHIEF FINANCIAL OFFICER NAME] are designated as joint signatories, with any two signatures required for all payments exceeding RMB [THRESHOLD], and one signature for payments below such threshold, subject to the Company’s internal control policy. 6. That the Company’s statutory books, seal, and chop shall be procured immediately, and the Finance and Legal Manager is authorized to acquire the company seal, financial seal, invoice seal, and legal representative seal in compliance with the public security bureau engraving regulations. 7. That the management is hereby directed to register the Company for corporate income tax, value-added tax, foreign trade operator registration with the Ministry of Commerce, customs registration with the General Administration of Customs, liquor export licensing, and any other filings required by the applicable laws, regulations, and international trade conventions. 8. That any officer or agent of the Company is hereby authorized to sign, seal, file, and deliver any documents necessary to consummate the incorporation, licensing, licensing renewal, banking, and regulatory compliance matters described in these resolutions. 9. That this resolution may be executed in counterparts and shall be effective as of the date first written above, notwithstanding the date of actual execution by any director. 10. That the Company Secretary is directed to enter these resolutions in the minutes book and to deliver a certified copy to each statutory officer and the competent authorities upon request. THE FOREGOING RESOLUTION WAS unanimously adopted and recorded. CERTIFIED BY: [SECRETARY NAME], Corporate Secretary; DATED: [DATE].

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Pre-incorporation name reservation and foreign investment project filing
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: State Administration for Market Regulation (SAMR) via the national online enterprise registration portal (China Enterprise Registration Service) and local Municipal Market Supervision Administration
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit an application for pre-approval of the proposed Chinese company name using the standardized format 'City + Trade Name + Industry + Company Limited'. At this stage, the foreign investor must ensure that the proposed name does not conflict with existing registrations and does not contain prohibited words. Prepare and submit a foreign investment industrial project filing or information report through the MOFCOM Foreign Investment Comprehensive Management Information System because the intended scope of wholesale distribution and export of baijiu liquor falls within the permitted category for foreign investment, not being in the prohibited or restricted list. The applicant must notarize and apostille or legalize the investor's certificate of incorporation and the passport or identity documents of the legal representative; where the home jurisdiction is Taiwan, provide a notarized certificate of incorporation, shareholders' register, and proof of address. The filing must state the total investment, registered capital, contribution ratio, and the proposed business scope in both English and Chinese transliteration. Submit the pre-approval dossier online, pay no registration fee, and await a name reservation certificate and foreign investment filing confirmation. The name reservation is valid for 6 months, and the local SAMR may require that the business address be preliminarily verified through a lease intention letter. If any document is defective, the regulator will issue an electronic notice of correction; the legal representative must correct and resubmit within the specified 15-day window.
required_dossiers: Application for enterprise name reservation signed by the foreign investor
Notarized and legalized certificate of incorporation of the parent company
Notarized and legalized passport copies and proof of address of directors
Proposed Articles of Association (draft)
Foreign investment information report
Lease intention letter for the proposed registered office
Power of attorney appointing the local registration agent
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the name reservation is rejected or queried, inspect the electronic rejection reason in the SAMR portal and file a corrective amendment. Where the name conflicts with an earlier registration, choose an alternate name or append a distinctive trade mark or geographical element. If the foreign investment filing is suspended, respond to MOFCOM's supplemental comment within 10 working days with a revised feasibility statement and an accurate industry classification, and request administrative reconsideration if the rejection is unlawful.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Notarization and submission of Articles of Association and incorporation registration
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Municipal Market Supervision Administration (registration window or online filing system) with MOFCOM foreign investment information filing coordination
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: After the name reservation certificate is issued, draft and execute the final Articles of Association in Chinese, signed by the sole shareholder or all subscribing shareholders and initial directors. The Articles must contain the company name, registered address, scope of business including 'liquor export wholesale' and 'prepackaged food and liquor sales', registered capital, shareholder's rights and obligations, board composition, legal representative appointment, duration of the company, and liquidation provisions. Arrange notarization of the shareholder's corporate resolutions, board appointments, and lease agreement for the registered office. File the incorporation application through the SAMR one-stop online portal together with the articles, identity certificates, lease proof, the investor's qualification proof, and the name reservation certificate. The local Market Supervision Administration will conduct a formal review and issue the Business License (Unified Social Credit Code) upon approval. The license is the statutory proof of establishment, and the company must complete its seal engraving immediately after receiving the license, including the company seal, financial seal, invoice seal, and legal representative personal seal. This stage must also generate the E-file code for the enterprise and open a basic deposit account at a bank within one month thereafter.
required_dossiers: Pre-approved name reservation certificate
Final executed Articles of Association
Board of directors appointment minutes or written resolution
Notarized lease agreement or certificate of title for the registered office
Investor's notarized and legalized corporate documents and bank financial statements
Passport copies and Chinese visa or residence permit of the legal representative
Foreign investment information filing confirmation
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the SAMR submits a correction request, rectify the deficiency through the online portal within 15 working days; if the lease certificate is questioned, obtain a renewed landlord certificate and a stamped property ownership certificate. If the shareholder or legal representative documentation lacks legalization, re-submit with an apostille or consulate legalization. In case of a refusal, appeal to the higher-level Administration for Market Regulation or initiate administrative reconsideration, while simultaneously correcting the business scope to exclude prohibited activities if needed.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Post-incorporation registrations: tax, customs, foreign exchange, liquor operating license and alcohol export registration
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: State Taxation Administration (local tax bureau), General Administration of Customs, State Administration of Foreign Exchange, and provincial or municipal Market Supervision Administration / China Alcohol License administrative authority
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Upon obtaining the business license, the WFOE must complete the tax registration with the local State Taxation Administration office and obtain a taxpayer identification number through the one-stop service, including corporate income tax, value-added tax, and withholding tax registrations. Register for customs import/export operations with the General Administration of Customs and obtain a customs registration certificate and ten-digit customs code. For exporting baijiu, apply for a liquor export wholesale license or an alcohol wholesale/distribution permit with the competent provincial or municipal commercial authority, since ISIC 4632 is wholesale distribution of alcoholic beverages. Additionally, obtain a food business license for prepackaged alcohol sale if physically handling goods; where the business is pure cross-border trading without touching inventory, the food business license may not apply, but an export conformity certificate from the local market supervision bureau may be required. Complete foreign exchange registration through the SAFE branch and designate a bank to handle the basic deposit account and capital account under the foreign exchange control system. Register with the local commerce bureau for the Foreign Trade Operator Filing and obtain a foreign trade operator registration certificate. Register with the Chinese customs intellectual property recordal system if the baijiu brand is proprietary. This stage also includes the activation of the electronic invoice system and applying for a digital tax control device, if applicable.
required_dossiers: Business license with unified social credit code
Seal registration certificates
Legal representative passport and residence permit
Articles of Association and board resolution designating the authorized signatories
Bank account opening permit or bank certificate
Liquor export wholesale license application form
Food business license application and facility plan (if applicable)
Product testing certificate for alcohol content and safety compliance
China Compulsory Certification (CCC) exemption certificate or conformity assessment report for export goods
Foreign exchange registration forms and capital payment confirmation
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the tax registration is delayed or rejected, resubmit the unified social credit code certificate and the legal representative identity documents through the one-stop tax service window and apply for late-filing mitigation. If the liquor license application is suspended due to missing food safety documentation, submit a third-party laboratory certificate showing the baijiu meets GB/T 10781 standards for strong aroma and GB 2757 distilled liquor hygiene requirements. If customs registration is queried, provide a corrected commodity HS classification and a licensed exporter statement; for any adverse rejection, pursue internal appeal within the administrative agency within 60 days and then administrative litigation in the local people's court if necessary.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Bank account activation, capital contribution verification, and statutory governance book closing
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Commercial bank (branch) and local SAMR / National Enterprise Credit Information Publicity System (NECIPS)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: After the company is registered, open the basic deposit account at the selected designated bank branch. The legal representative and authorized joint signatories must appear physically or by other secure means consistent with the bank's anti-money laundering procedures; submit a board resolution, the business license, the company seal, financial seal, and all statutory officer identity proof. The bank will obtain a registration from the People's Bank of China and issue the bank account license or online verification. The foreign investor must make a remittance of the initial paid-in capital to the capital account or basic account, and the bank must issue a capital contribution verification notice. In accordance with the Articles of Association and SAMR requirements, the company must file the paid-in capital contribution through the National Enterprise Credit Information Publicity System. The statutory governance book must be prepared containing the board minutes, shareholder's resolutions, share register, corporate records, and a register of seals and personnel. Submit the capital contribution declaration to the local SAMR through the annual reporting or change filing window, and ensure that the company's registered capital is fully recorded in the enterprise credit system. This step concludes with the issuance of the official certificate of incorporation and the official company chop affixed to the statutory records.
required_dossiers: Business license
Board resolution authorizing bank account opening and signing matrix
Company seal, financial seal, and legal representative seal
Passport and residence permit of the legal representative
Initial capital remittance wire receipt or bank certificate
Articles of Association
Anti-money laundering questionnaires and beneficial ownership declaration
Corporate governance book template and share certificate stubs
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the bank account opening is refused or delayed due to AML concerns, provide supplementary documentation of the ultimate beneficial owner, the source of funds, and the projected export trade flows. If the capital contribution verification is queried, obtain a corrected bank stamp and resubmit the remittance certificate to the local SAMR. In the case of governance book errors, correct them internally and file an administrative correction notice with the SAMR if the public credit record is affected.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: State Administration for Market Regulation (SAMR), Ministry of Commerce (MOFCOM), China National Intellectual Property Administration for brand-related product licensing, and the local Municipal Commerce Bureau / Market Supervision Administration for the liquor wholesale and export operation license.
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Liquor Wholesale and Export Distribution License and Foreign Trade Operator Registration; additionally, a Food Business License for prepackaged alcoholic beverages if the enterprise physically receives or stores inventory.

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Ministry of Ecology and Environment (MEE) and local Ecology and Environment Bureau; Frontier Customs and Export Inspection authority for shipment compliance
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Environmental Registration or 'Not Applicable' for a pure export distribution and wholesale trading enterprise without physical production, blending or bottling. If the WFOE establishes a bonded warehouse or repackaging facility, a full EIA report under the 'Construction Project Environmental Impact Assessment Classification List' may be required, typically Category II or III, requiring an environmental impact registration form; if bottling or blending of alcohol is added in a factory, a full EIA report may be mandatory.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: For a pure wholesale/export entity with no industrial discharge: N/A. For any warehousing or repackaging operation, wastewater discharge must comply with GB 8978-1996 Integrated Wastewater Discharge Standard (COD ≤ 100 mg/L, BOD5 ≤ 30 mg/L, SS ≤ 70 mg/L for existing facilities, or municipal sewer pre-treatment standards), volatile organic compounds (VOCs) from any solvent or flavoring handling must meet GB 37822-2019 VOC fugitive emission limits of 0.6 mg/m3 for nonmethane total hydrocarbons at boundary and 80 mg/m3 in workshop concentration, and hazardous waste storage must follow the Hazardous Waste Identification Standard (GB 5085) with manifest and licensed transfer to a qualified disposal facility.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Fire Protection Acceptance Check and Fire Safety Filing under the Fire Protection Law of the PRC (2019 revision), including issuance of the Fire Safety Inspection Certificate for public places or a fire safety filing for a registered office and warehouse; structural load certification of warehousing floors; and workplace safety approval under the Work Safety Law, requiring a safety management system, emergency evacuation plan, and fire extinguishing equipment inspection for any stored alcoholic product with a flash point above 28°C, and occupational health clearance if no physical workplace hazards exist.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: State Taxation Administration (STA) of the People's Republic of China; electronic portal: e-Tax Bureau (https://etax.chinatax.gov.cn)
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: For a Wholly Foreign-Owned Enterprise (WFOE) established in mainland China, the entity must first obtain a Unified Social Credit Code (USCC) from the Administration for Market Regulation (AMR) during incorporation. The USCC serves as the sole Tax Identification Number (TIN) for all tax purposes. Subsequently, the WFOE must complete tax registration with the local STA office within 30 days of obtaining the business license, either online via the e-Tax Bureau or in person. The registration process requires submission of the business license, articles of association, legal representative identification, and proof of registered address. Upon completion, the entity is automatically enrolled for Corporate Income Tax (CIT), Value-Added Tax (VAT), and other applicable taxes. For foreign non-resident entities without a permanent establishment, a separate tax registration for withholding purposes is required, but this does not apply to the WFOE itself, which is a resident entity.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: Election to be treated as a small-scale VAT taxpayer (annual taxable sales below RMB 5,000,000) or as a general VAT taxpayer (annual taxable sales at or above RMB 5,000,000); no check-the-box or hybrid mismatch elections are available under Chinese tax law.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: Mandatory registration as a general VAT taxpayer when annual taxable sales exceed RMB 5,000,000; below this threshold, small-scale taxpayer status applies with a 3% collection rate (or 1% for certain qualifying small-scale taxpayers).
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: All VAT invoices must be issued through the State Taxation Administration's Golden Tax System (GTS) using the official e-invoice platform. Invoices are transmitted in real-time to the STA's central database, and each invoice is assigned a unique anti-fraud code and digital stamp. The system enforces mandatory data validation, including buyer and seller USCCs, product descriptions, and tax rates. No separate physical clearance is required, but the electronic data must match the customs export declaration for zero-rated exports.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Exports of goods (including Chinese Baijiu liquor) are eligible for a 0% VAT rate provided the exporter is a general VAT taxpayer, the goods are physically exported from mainland China to a foreign destination (including Taiwan), and the exporter has collected all required export documentation. The zero-rating applies to the export sale, and the exporter may claim a refund of input VAT attributable to the exported goods.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs Export Declaration (Export Goods Declaration Form)
Bill of Lading (or Air Waybill for air freight)
Export Proceeds Collection Certificate (formerly Inward Remittance Certificate)
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: The STA conducts rigorous audits of export zero-rating claims. If documentation is incomplete, fraudulent, or if export proceeds are not repatriated within the 180-day deadline, the tax authority will disallow the zero-rating, require repayment of any VAT refund received, and impose a late payment surcharge of 0.05% per day. In cases of deliberate fraud, penalties range from 50% to 500% of the tax evaded, and criminal liability may be pursued under the Criminal Law for tax evasion.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: State Administration of Foreign Exchange (SAFE) under the People's Bank of China (PBOC)
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: The PRC maintains a bifurcated convertibility regime. Current-account transactions, including the export of Chinese baijiu liquor, are generally convertible upon presentation of a bona fide underlying trade contract, customs declaration, commercial invoice, packing list, and transport documents. However, the New Taiwan Dollar is not a freely convertible settlement currency, so export invoicing to Taiwan is normally denominated in US dollars, RMB, or another acceptable major currency. Capital-account transactions remain strictly regulated: shareholder loans, paid-in capital injections, and profit repatriations require prior SAFE registration, FDI capital verification, audited financial statements, tax clearance certificates, and documented use of funds. For a WFOE, foreign registered capital must be injected through a dedicated capital account and can be converted into RMB under the voluntary settlement policy strictly for working-capital purposes. Profit remittance to the overseas parent is permitted only after annual statutory audit, corporate income tax settlement, and submission of a board resolution, with applicable dividend withholding tax paid. Export trade proceeds must be repatriated into a domestic foreign-exchange settlement account within the statutory period and are continuously monitored through SAFE's cross-border receipt and payment verification system. Overall, convertibility is liberal for genuine trade but procedurally robust, and there is no free-floating convertibility for speculative or unrelated capital flows.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: There is no mandatory conversion ratio for export proceeds; the exporter may voluntarily convert 0% to 100% of foreign-currency receipts held in an export settlement account. However, the full amount of export proceeds must be repatriated to a domestic SAFE-supervised trade settlement account within 90 calendar days from the date of customs export declaration. If collection extends beyond 90 days due to commercial terms, the WFOE must submit a deferred collection report through the banking channel to SAFE. Banks validate trade authenticity against the customs declaration number, invoice, and logistics evidence before any crediting or settlement.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Capital Escrow Account and Trade Foreign Exchange Settlement Account

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.bank_name: Industrial and Commercial Bank of China (ICBC)
tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Basic Operational Currency Account and Export Settlement Account
Capital Verification Account and General Trade Settlement Account
Basic Deposit Account and Foreign Currency Account for Trade

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Low and largely prohibited for primary banking. PRC foreign-exchange law requires all cross-border trade receipts and expenditures to be settled through designated domestic banks registered with SAFE. Offshore fintech EMIs, such as global digital wallet providers or electronic money institutions without a mainland China banking license, cannot act as the primary settlement rail for a Chinese WFOE. They may provide ancillary payment collection tools outside China, but the funds must ultimately be repatriated through a licensed domestic bank under a verified trade background. Attempts to use unlicensed EMIs for export proceeds repatriation would trigger AML red flags and could result in SAFE penalties, denial of customs verification, and freezing of assets. Therefore, the WFOE must bank with a domestic Tier-1 commercial bank; fintech EMI usage is limited only to short-term foreign marketing or client-side convenience and never as a substitute for regulated cross-border clearing.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: Statutory directors and the beneficial owner are required to appear physically in-branch for a face-to-face KYC interview during the account-opening and foreign-exchange registration process. Remote consular proxy opening is not broadly accepted for a new WFOE with an active export trading business; however, certain pilot zones such as the Shanghai Free Trade Zone allow a notarized power-of-attorney arrangement with a senior appointed manager attending in person, provided the ultimate beneficial owner completes a video-call interview and provides notarized identification documents. Given the alcohol-export scope, the bank compliance team will need to verify the legal purpose and ownership chain. In practice, full physical presence by at least one statutory director and the appointed financial controller is strongly recommended to avoid underwriting delays and to satisfy local People's Bank of China branch expectations.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Apparent mismatch between WFOE's manufacturing or export capacity and the projected volume of high-proof baijiu exports to Taiwan; the bank may suspect trade-based money laundering or over-invoicing.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Provide a complete supply chain audit trail: supply agreements with licensed sorghum distilleries, holding tank certificates, batch-level inventory logs, third-party inspection certificates, customs export declarations for prior shipments, and if available, an independent warehouse audit report confirming physical goods movements. Add the PRC alcohol export license and food safety business license. Include an explainable business plan showing annual capacity, per-unit cost, freight insurance, and expected gross margins.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Concentration of receipts from a single Taiwan counterparty or repeated payments arriving from third-party accounts rather than the contracted buyer, which suggests possible layering or sanctions-evasion.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Provide the legally executed export sales contract with the named Taiwan importer, the buyer's certificate of incorporation or business registration, its bank confirmation letter, and signed distribution agreements with final end-customers. If third-party payments are unavoidable, supply a tripartite debt assignment or payment instruction letter signed by all parties, plus the commercial invoice and full MT103 trail showing the original beneficiary designation. Maintain a rolling schedule of receivables and payment matching for at least 24 months.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Unusually rapid capital injection followed by immediate conversion to RMB and withdrawal for unrelated expenditures, suggesting round-tripping or violation of FDI capital use restrictions.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Provide the SAFE FDI registration certificate, the capital injection bank statements, the shareholders' capital contribution resolution, a board-approved cash-flow forecast linked to baijiu procurement and export costs, and invoices for rice, sorghum, glass bottling, packaging, and freight. Demonstrate that no funds are diverted to real estate, securities trading, or entrusted loans beyond prohibited boundaries. Present a statutory audit confirming that capital has been applied consistently with registered business scope.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Inconsistent or missing transportation documents for high-value cargo, particularly when destination port information or vessel/truck identifiers do not align with declared customs route to Taiwan.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Assemble complete export documentation for every shipment: original bill of lading or airway bill showing the actual port of discharge in Taiwan, customs pre-advice forms, freight forwarders' booking confirmations, container tracking logs, vehicle GPS logs for cross-border land or sea routes, CMR or sea waybill equivalents, and cargo insurance certificates naming the WFOE as beneficiary. Include a service agreement with the licensed freight forwarder and annual confirmation from the Taiwan customs broker that the goods were legally entered.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: For inbound FDI, the WFOE must first obtain the SAFE Foreign Investment Registration Certificate from the local administration. Shareholders' capital transfers are wired from the overseas parent's bank to the WFOE's capital verification account at a designated Tier-1 Chinese bank using SWIFT MT103 with the purpose code 'Foreign Direct Investment – Registered Capital'. The remittance statement must cite the SAFE registration number. After receipt, the bank performs capital verification, records the transaction in the SAFE system, and upon presentation of the enterprise operating license and board resolution, the funds may be converted into RMB under the voluntary settlement policy. The RMB proceeds must be held in a designated enterprise account and strictly used for operating expenses, procurement of baijiu inventory, and permissible working capital. Any change in investment structure requires an amendment to SAFE registration before further flows. For export trade, inbound payment from Taiwan buyers is routed to the WFOE's export settlement account using SWIFT MT103 with purpose code 'Foreign Trade Receipt – Export of Goods', accompanied by the relevant customs declaration and proof of shipping.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Outbound funds from the WFOE primarily consist of supplier payments for raw materials, bottling services, freight and insurance, packaging materials, and certain cross-border taxes or fees. Corporate-to-corporate payments are executed via SWIFT MT103 with a proper transaction purpose code and supporting trade documents. For larger and recurring import transactions, the WFOE may open irrevocable documented commercial letters of credit (L/Cs) at the same Tier-1 bank for the benefit of domestic suppliers, guaranteeing payment against transport and quality certificates. Documentary collections under the ICC Uniform Rules are acceptable for smaller payments with known counterparties. All outbound disbursements must pass through SAFE's cross-border monitoring system; no cash withdrawals, nonsensical split payments, or settlements through unlicensed third parties are permitted. For Taiwan-bound export proceeds, the WFOE may also use documents against acceptance or payment with a confirming bank if the Taiwan buyer requires trade finance. The clearing rails should be restricted to well-established global correspondent banking networks to ensure full transparency and auditability.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Onshore deliverable CNY/USD forward contracts with maturity up to 12 months, executed with a SAFE-approved domestic bank under a signed master hedging agreement, with the underlying trade exposure evidenced by an export order or import contract.
Cross-currency swaps between CNY and USD for medium-term liquidity needs, provided that both legs are for genuine trade and the notional does not exceed the company's verified trade flows.

FX options such as vanilla European call or put options on USD/CNY sold to the WFOE by the domestic bank for hedging purposes only, subject to the bank's risk disclosure and record-keeping requirements.

Non-deliverable forwards (NDFs) are prohibited for onshore legal entities; they are permitted only in offshore markets and may not be booked with a domestic Chinese bank. All hedging instruments must be economically linked to the underlying baijiu export receivables and cannot be used for speculation.

corporate_income_tax_regime.statutory_headline_rate: 25% standard Enterprise Income Tax rate on worldwide income for a PRC-resident Wholly Foreign-Owned Enterprise, unless a lower preferential rate applies.
corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: No general statutory tax holiday for a WFOE engaged in spirits export distribution. Mainland China currently applies a reduced effective rate of 5% for small low-profit enterprises with annual taxable income up to RMB 3,000,000, not more than 300 employees and total assets not exceeding RMB 50,000,000; a 15% rate for High/New-Technology Enterprises and certain encouraged industries; an additional weighted deduction for qualified R&D expenses; and regional incentives such as the 15% Hainan Free Trade Port rate. A baijiu export wholesaler must meet the specific eligibility requirements for each incentive; the benchmark regime is 25%.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Form A100000, Enterprise Income Tax Annual Tax Return (A-Class, 2017 Edition), together with applicable schedules such as A105000, A105050, A105080, A106000 and A107010; filed electronically through the State Taxation Administration Electronic Tax Bureau (电子税务局) or an approved provincial e-filing portal.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Within 5 months after the fiscal year-end; for a calendar-year WFOE, the deadline is 31 May of the following year.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: 营业收入: must include gross export revenue from wholesale baijiu sales recognized under PRC Accounting Standards for Business Enterprises.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: The WFOE files as a PRC resident enterprise and must report its worldwide income; revenue from Taiwan-registered affiliates must be recognized at arm's length and not netted against intercompany distribution costs unless contractually a commissionaire.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: 营业成本: cost of purchased baijiu, packaging, freight, and other direct costs of export sales.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Intercompany purchases of baijiu or related logistics services must be justified by transfer pricing documentation; understated or inflated costs may be adjusted by the tax authority.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: 税金及附加: deductible surtaxes, property-related taxes, stamp duties and other business taxes; VAT and consumption tax are not deducted here.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: The same deduction rules apply regardless of foreign ownership; no special non-resident filing entry is required.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: 销售费用: export logistics, overseas trade promotion, distributor commissions, and trade show expenses.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Commissions paid to a Taiwan-related distributor must satisfy the arm's length standard and must be supported by contracts and actual services; excessive commissions may be disallowed.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: 管理费用: salaries, office rent, professional fees, depreciation, and administration costs.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Management fees charged by a Taiwan parent or offshore affiliated office are deductible only if the WFOE proves actual services and that the fee is at arm's length; purely allocative head-office charges are non-deductible.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: 财务费用: bank charges, foreign exchange losses, and interest on financing
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Interest paid to a Taiwan shareholder or related lender is subject to thin capitalization rules and a 2:1 debt-to-equity restriction for related-party loans; excessive related-party interest is disallowed and may be recharacterized.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: 资产减值损失: eligible impairment allowances on receivables, inventory, and fixed assets.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Impairments must be evidenced; arbitrary allocations against intercompany receivables from Taiwan affiliates will require transfer pricing adjustment.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: 营业利润: calculated by combining the operating revenue and operating cost schedules.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: This is the WFOE's own operating profit before tax adjustments; no consolidation with the Taiwan shareholder is permitted.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: 利润总额: total accounting profit after non-operating income and expenses.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Report full PRC-source and foreign-source income of the WFOE; dividends received from a Taiwan subsidiary may be taxable unless qualifying for foreign tax credit or participation exemption conditions.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: 纳税调整增加额: permanent and temporary taxable increases, including disallowed entertainment, management fees, proportionate interest, and excess impairment.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Include disallowed interest expense on debt owed to Taiwan affiliates and any transfer pricing adjustments made in the prior year's audit.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: 纳税调整减少额: tax-exempt income, qualified R&D super deductions and statutory deductions.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Foreign tax credits are claimed via the foreign-tax credit schedules, not through line 15, unless a specific exemption applies.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: 纳税调整后所得: taxable accounting income after adjustment.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: No inbound or outbound transfer pricing adjustment may be omitted; the Taiwan tax authority has no jurisdiction over this mainland return.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: 弥补以前年度亏损: tax loss carryforward from prior assessed losses.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Carryforward is limited to 5 years from the loss year for a standard WFOE; loss offset is allowed only against the same WFOE's income.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: 应纳税所得额: final taxable income.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Must be determined independently after all related-party adjustments, withholding tax settlements and anti-avoidance recharacterizations.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: 税率: 25%, or the applicable 15% or 20% preferential rate if the WFOE qualifies.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: A Taiwan shareholder does not file this line; the WFOE computes tax on its own taxable income.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: 应纳所得税额: computed tax liability.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Must be substantiated by the detailed tax schedules and accounting records.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: 减免所得税额: tax exemptions and reductions, including preferential rates and regional credits.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Only apply where the WFOE itself meets statutory conditions; treaty-type benefits are not claimed by the entity in this field.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: 应纳税额: final annual Enterprise Income Tax payable.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: This amount is the WFOE's liability as a resident enterprise; it does not include withholding tax on dividends distributed to Taiwan shareholders.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: 实际已预缴税额: quarterly advance tax payments already settled.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: The WFOE must reconcile quarterly prepayments with the annual liability; underpayment attracts late-payment interest.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: 本年应补（退）所得税额: balance payable to or refundable from the tax authority.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: No balance owed by the Taiwan shareholder is reported here; the WFOE's distribution withholding obligation is a separate remittance.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late filing: order to remedy and a fixed fine of up to RMB 2,000, or RMB 10,000 for serious cases, under the Tax Collection Administration Law; late payment: daily surcharge of 0.05% of unpaid tax; false or fraudulent filing: penalty of 50% to 5 times the evaded tax plus criminal liability under PRC Criminal Law Article 201.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Form A200000, Enterprise Income Tax Monthly/Quarterly Provisional Tax Payment Return (A-Class), filed electronically through the SAT Electronic Tax Bureau (电子税务局).
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Within 15 days after the end of each quarter; for a calendar-year WFOE, the deadlines are 15 April, 15 July, 15 October and 15 January of the following year.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: 营业收入: quarterly operating revenue from export sales of baijiu.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: The WFOE completes all fields as the resident taxpayer; no separate non-resident reporting line exists.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: 营业成本: quarterly cost of sales.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Ensure intercompany purchase and logistics costs are recorded consistently with the annual transfer pricing documentation.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: 利润总额: quarterly accounting profit.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: The return is filed on the WFOE's own books and records, not on a group or Taiwan-consolidated basis.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: 实际利润额: actual quarterly profit after deduction of permitted prior-year losses and statutory adjustments.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Use the WFOE's standalone adjusted taxable profit; distributions from Taiwan affiliates are not included unless recognized as taxable investment income.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: 税率: 25% or an approved preferential rate.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: The rate applies to the WFOE only; a Taiwan shareholder has no direct entry in this return.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: 应纳所得税额: computed advance payment.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Advance payments must be conservative; deliberate underpayment can create exposure to penalties and surcharges.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: 减免所得税额: provisional tax reductions or exemptions claimed.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Claim only statutory domestic incentives, never tax treaty/double-taxation agreement reductions, in the provisional return.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: 实际应补（退）税额: actual amount payable or refundable after offsets from previous installments.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: The quarterly prepayment is credited against the final annual liability in the following year's annual return.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Failure to file by the 15-day deadline: fine of up to RMB 2,000, or RMB 10,000 in serious cases; underpayment: 0.05% daily late-payment surcharge; intentional false returns may be treated as tax evasion and attract a penalty of 50% to 5 times the evaded tax.

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.statutory_dividend_wht_rate: 10% of gross dividends paid by the PRC-resident WFOE to a non-resident enterprise shareholder, including a Taiwan-registered corporate shareholder, subject to any reduction under the applicable cross-strait tax arrangement or a recognized tax treaty provision.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: The WFOE, as withholding agent, must apply for reduced withholding tax by submitting the non-resident taxpayer treaty-benefit information report to the competent local tax authority and by providing a Taiwan tax-residence certificate, a beneficial-ownership declaration, shareholding proof and documentation showing that the Taiwan shareholder is not acting as a conduit. Approval depends on the operational status and scope of the Cross-Strait Agreement on Avoidance of Double Taxation; relief is not automatic and the tax authority may require additional anti-abuse review.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: Statutory withholding tax is 10% for interest and royalty income derived by a Taiwan non-resident enterprise from mainland sources. An applicable cross-strait tax arrangement or PRC treaty may reduce the rate for beneficial owners, but the reduced rate is generally limited to 5%-10% depending on the character of income and the degree of ownership; royalties for intellectual property and interest on debt financing must be supported by genuine legal and economic substance, and a withholding obligation is triggered at the time of payment or accrual.

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: Mandatory Local File under SAT Public Announcement 2016 No. 42 arises for the WFOE if annual related-party transactions exceed any of: RMB 200 million for tangible asset buy/sell transactions; RMB 100 million for intangible asset transfers or licenses; RMB 100 million for financial asset transfers; or RMB 40 million for all other related-party transactions. A Master File is required when the global ultimate parent of the group has consolidated revenue above RMB 5.5 billion in the prior fiscal year.
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: The PRC does not apply a standalone Economic Substance Regulations regime as seen in certain offshore financial centres. Instead, China enforces substance-over-form, the general anti-avoidance rule under EIT Law Article 47, beneficial ownership requirements, controlled foreign corporation rules and related-party transaction documentation to disregard artificial structures. A mainland WFOE and its Taiwan intermediate holding company must demonstrate actual offices, employees, risk control, board decision-making and real commercial functions to avoid recharacterization of profits and denial of treaty-type relief.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Deliberately under-reporting baijiu export revenue, concealing payments received in offshore accounts, fabricating purchase invoices, inflating costs, destroying records or materially misstating related-party transactions.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: The tax authority may reassess tax due with a 0.05% daily late-payment surcharge and impose an administrative penalty of 50% to 5 times the evaded tax; criminal conviction for tax evasion under PRC Criminal Law Article 201 can lead to up to 7 years' imprisonment and fines.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Legal representatives, financial officers and beneficial shareholders who directed or concealed the evasion may be jointly and severally liable for unpaid tax and civil damages; courts may order travel bans, exit restrictions, asset freezes and imprisonment.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Export Tax Rebate and Customs Fraud
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: False export declarations for high-proof baijiu, inflated prices, misdeclared quantities, circular export through affiliated entities in Taiwan or a third jurisdiction, counterfeit customs documents or fraudulent claims for VAT export rebates.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Repayment of all fraudulently obtained export tax refunds, administrative penalties of 1 to 5 times the refund amount, customs penalties and forfeiture; criminal liability under Criminal Law Article 204 can include imprisonment up to life and fines.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors and responsible staff may face criminal prosecution, personal fines, travel bans, confiscation of personal assets and disqualification from serving as corporate officers; the corporate veil will be pierced where illicit intent and personal control are proved.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Operating a mainland WFOE or Taiwan intermediate company without employees, premises, commercial functions or real income-generating activity; artificially routing baijiu export sales through the Taiwan entity solely to obtain a reduced dividend withholding tax or to defer mainland tax.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: The tax authority may disregard the artificial arrangement under general anti-avoidance rules, recharacterize income, deny treaty or cross-strait relief, assess the resident entity at 25%, apply 10% dividend withholding tax and impose penalties and daily surcharges; the controlled foreign corporation rules can currently tax undistributed profits in the hands of mainland controlling shareholders.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Shareholders and directors who created or operated the conduit may be jointly liable for restored taxes; courts may issue travel bans, freeze bank accounts and impose criminal sanctions for fraudulent avoidance.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Receiving baijiu export proceeds through unofficial money channels, structuring wire transfers beneath reporting thresholds, dealing with shell distributors, false invoicing, multiple counts of under-invoicing or over-invoicing, or movements of high-value spirits without proper customs or foreign-exchange declaration.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: PRC AML Law and Criminal Law Article 191 authorize account freezing, asset confiscation, regulatory fines, customs penalties and imprisonment for money laundering; criminal penalties may be aggravated when cross-border trade-based laundering is proved.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Beneficial owners, compliance officers and responsible directors can be prosecuted personally, with exposure to imprisonment, confiscation of personal property, travel bans and prohibition from re-entering mainland or Taiwan financial sectors.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Transfer Pricing Non-Arm's-Length and Withholding Failure
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Setting intercompany baijiu purchase prices, commissions, royalty rates, interest rates or management fees outside arm's length; failing to file the Annual Related-Party Transaction Reporting Forms; failing to withhold and remit 10% tax on dividends paid to the Taiwan shareholder; or engaging in thin capitalization arrangements.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: The tax authority may adjust taxable income, impose a daily 0.05% late-payment surcharge, apply a transfer pricing penalty where documentation is false or incomplete, and assess a withholding penalty of 50% to 3 times the tax not withheld under Tax Collection Administration Law Article 69; retrospective adjustments can cover 5 to 10 years.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors and financial officers who sign false transfer pricing disclosures or knowingly fail to withhold face personal enforcement, civil damages, travel bans and, in egregious cases, criminal liability for fraud or tax evasion.
